body.name: Graph-indexed response architecture list
body.construction: Enumerate a topological order on \(W\), a subset of its \(N(N-1)/2\) forward directed slots, and a subset of the \(2^N-1\) nonempty child sets indexing independent exogenous sources. This produces at most \(A_{\max}=N!\,2^{N(N-1)/2+2^N-1}\) labeled architectures before duplicate removal. For each architecture enumerate all deterministic tables, bounded by \(R_{\max}\), using at most \(K_{\max}=m+3\) values per source, and retain each projected selected MAG \(G\in\mathcal G(\mathcal P)\).
